text: When you understand that the lat pulldown goes to the chin and not the chest, the lats will come. When you understand that the elbows and the biceps are not behind but a little bit forward, the biceps will grow. When you understand that the rope tricep extensions don't go to the body but to the floor, the triceps will come. When you understand that for the lateral raise, you don't have to go all the way up here but to shoulder height, the shoulders will pop. When you understand that your seated cable row doesn't go to your chest but to your waist, the lats will come. And most importantly, when you follow me, your muscles will grow.
